channel.title: Detroit Sports Nation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Detroit Sports Nation (detroitsportsnation.com)

item.title: Legendary Notre Dame Coach Lou Holtz Dies
item.description: Legendary college football coach Lou Holtz has died at the age of 89. The Hall of Fame coach led Notre Dame to the 1988 national championship and impacted generations of players.

item.title: Jake Bates’ Future With the Lions Just Became Clear
item.description: The Detroit Lions have tendered kicker Jake Bates an ERFA contract, ensuring he will remain with the team for the 2026 season.

item.title: Jahmyr Gibbs Already Leading Major NFL Award Race for 2026
item.description: Detroit Lions running back Jahmyr Gibbs has opened as the betting favorite to win the 2026 NFL Offensive Player of the Year award following the David Montgomery trade.

item.title: Detroit Lions Urged to Sign Future Hall of Fame Defender
item.description: A new Sports Illustrated report suggests the Detroit Lions should sign future Hall of Fame defender Khalil Mack to pair with Aidan Hutchinson.

item.title: Detroit Lions Eye Physical SEC Edge Rusher in Top-30 Visit
item.description: The Detroit Lions have scheduled their first top-30 visit of the draft cycle with Tennessee defensive lineman Tyre West as they continue evaluating pass rush help.

item.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown Reacts Emotionally to David Montgomery Trade
item.description: Detroit Lions star Amon-Ra St. Brown says he is “sick” about the team trading running back David Montgomery but believes his former teammate will thrive with the Houston Texans.

item.title: Detroit Tigers Announce First ‘Stunning’ Decision of Spring Training
item.description: The Detroit Tigers optioned right-hander Keider Montero to Triple-A Toledo shortly after he pitched three scoreless innings, a move aimed at keeping him stretched out as a starter.

item.title: Report: Detroit Lions Hosting Former Top-10 Pick With Hopes of Bolstering O-Line
item.description: The Detroit Lions are hosting former Browns offensive tackle Jedrick Wills, a former top-10 pick recovering from injury, as part of their ongoing roster evaluations.

item.title: Did the Detroit Lions Answer at EDGE Just Become Available?
item.description: Veteran pass rusher Cameron Jordan could hit free agency for the first time in his career, and Lions coach Dan Campbell knows him well from their time together in New Orleans.

item.title: Max Clark’s Viral Instagram Post Sparks Backlash from Tigers Fans
item.description: Detroit Tigers prospect Max Clark is facing criticism from fans after a viral Instagram post showing luxury watches and cash sparked debate on social media.
